claims.statement: SemService encapsulates search, show, ask, list_names, and doctor without Typer or Rich dependencies, caching a read-only SQLite connection and automatically reloading both the DB handle and mmap embeddings when index.meta changes.

SemDaemonServer binds a user-private 0600 Unix domain socket guarded by a non-blocking fcntl.flock on sem.lock, serves newline-delimited JSON-RPC requests, and automatically shuts down after daemon.idle_timeout_seconds of inactivity.

DaemonClient and protocol use only Python standard-library modules with 2 MiB max newline-delimited JSON frames, enabling try_fast_porcelain_ask to serve warm-daemon Ctrl+S queries without importing Typer, Rich, or ML runtimes.

When auto_start is enabled and no daemon is listening, DaemonClient spawns `python -m sempropos.daemon` in a detached session and polls ping readiness for up to three seconds before retrying the request.
